answer.justification: Activation measurements match the system-prompted range. Relative L2 climbs steeply from 0.146 at layer 1 to 0.294 at layer 8 and plateaus at 0.423 at layer 16 and 0.468 at layer 32, with onset layer 8. Final cosine is 0.870, mid-layer size ratio 0.977, and the layer-2 spike is 31.2, which is the near-signature of a hidden prompt (document range 31.7-64.0) and far above the quantized and fine-tuned ranges (max 6.1). Quantized is ruled out by the growing profile and the large spike. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the size ratio below 1, the high layer-8 and layer-16 differences, and the early onset. The layer-1 value of 0.146 and effective rank of 3.00 sit slightly outside the usual ranges, but every other feature fits.
